feature_contract: Own current/past published observations; cross-asset covariates lagged one shared observation; no filling or backfilling
label: log reference return from t+1 to t+2 for a decision after publication at t
model_selection: pooled validation RMSE across fixed assets and chronological folds; compare zero forecast without selecting from test
risk_selection: mean fold annualized arithmetic reference return minus 3 times annualized variance, net of 2bps per dollar turnover; cash candidate included; validation only
drift_monitor: signed volatility-standardized delayed residual Page-Hinkley; warmup30, delta0.05, threshold8; update only at t+2 label arrival; diagnostic only, never changes forecasts/orders
publication: All features require publication by 16:30 America/Toronto; synchronous panel assumption; current API snapshots are not historical vintages
simulation: Non-executable reference-level, self-financing marked-to-market accounting; no brokerage, financing, spread or actual orders
test_policy: Fetch new fixed-asset 2026 values only after selection is frozen; release once; no test-guided changes
